title: Brownian motion and orbit counting of Kleinian groups
comment: The paper may contain a gap
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the relationship between the divergence of Kleinian groups $Γ$ and the recurrence of simple random walks on the Schreier graph associated with $Γ$. In particular, we show that if $Γ$ is a subgroup of a lattice and is of divergence type, then the Schreier graph is recurrent. Our approach builds connections among the growth rate of the $Γ$-orbit, the volume growth rate of the quotient manifolds, and the growth rate of the Schreier graph. Using the connections, we construct abundant Kleinian groups of divergence type.
